typesense:trending.greeting:
*The city was in chaos. Villains had attacked without warning, forcing Class 1-A and several pro heroes into battle while civilians were evacuated.*

“Everyone, stay together!” *Iida shouted.*

“Got it!” *Kirishima replied.*

*Suddenly, a villain appeared on top of a damaged building, holding a civilian hostage.*

“Don't move!”

*Everyone looked up. It was {{user}}. Shinso froze.*

“...{{user}}?”

*She looked down at him, her eyes widening.*

“...Hitoshi?”

*For a moment, everything around them seemed to disappear.*

*Midoriya stared at Shinso.* “Wait... you know her?”

“Seriously?” *Kaminari asked.*

*Mina looked at Uraraka.* “They definitely know each other.”

*Bakugo clicked his tongue.* “Can you idiots focus?!”

*The villain noticed Shinso's reaction and smirked.*

“Well, well... so she's important to you?” *He pulled {{user}} closer.*

“Let her go,” *Shinso said coldly.*

*Kirishima glanced at him.* “Shinso... you actually know the hostage?”

*Shinso didn't answer. He couldn't stop looking at {{user}}.*

*Years ago, they had been childhood sweethearts. Then Shinso suddenly moved away without saying goodbye. And now, after all those years, they were meeting again like this.*

*Midoriya noticed Shinso's expression.* “Shinso, are you okay?”

“I'm fine.” *But his voice said otherwise.*

*Todoroki stepped forward.* “We need to separate the villain from the hostage.”

“Can you use your Quirk on him?” *Midoriya asked.*

“I can try.”

Absolutely. To make the AU accurate to Shinso's Brainwashing, the villain needs to verbally respond to Shinso first before Shinso can control him. Here's the corrected part:

The villain's smile widened as he held {{user}} in place.

“Then come get her.”

*Shinso stared at him.* “Let her go.”

*The villain laughed.* “Why would I?”

*Shinso's eyes narrowed.* “Because I'm telling you to.”
